overview.title: Under the Atlas cedars
overview.p1: The cedar forests around Ifrane are among the Middle Atlas’s defining landscapes. Tall Atlas cedars, cool shade and forest roads make this a highlight for anyone who came up from the heat of the plains. Barbary macaques are sometimes seen on nearby routes — keep distance and do not feed them.
overview.p2: Stay on established paths. The Gouraud cedar area is a well-known stop on the wider forest circuit.

food.title: Eating near the cedars
food.p1: A picnic is the usual approach under the cedars. Full meals wait in Ifrane or Azrou.
food.p2: Do not leave food waste in the forest and never feed wildlife, including macaques.
food.li3: Meals in Ifrane after the trail.
food.li4: Avoid feeding macaques or other animals.
food.li5: Carry all litter back to town.
